vo.text: This electric kettle switches itself off when the water boils.
vo.speak: This electric kettle switches itself off when the water boils.

vo.text: A small steam-activated thermostat makes that automatic decision.
vo.speak: A small steam-activated thermostat makes that automatic decision.

vo.text: While heating, an electric element sends heat into the water.
vo.speak: While heating, an electric element sends heat into the water.

vo.text: When the water boils, steam rises through a small channel toward the thermostat.
vo.speak: When the water boils, steam rises through a small channel toward the thermostat.

vo.text: Inside it, a bimetallic strip made of two metals bends as steam heats it.
vo.speak: Inside it, a bimetallic strip made of two metals bends as steam heats it.

vo.text: The two metals expand by different amounts, forcing the strip to curve.
vo.speak: The two metals expand by different amounts, forcing the strip to curve.

vo.text: That movement trips a mechanical switch and disconnects the heating element.
vo.speak: That movement trips a mechanical switch and disconnects the heating element.

vo.text: So boiling water creates the steam signal that physically cuts the kettle's power.
